The Ahsan difference

Support that fits who you are

A good match is the difference between support that feels like an intrusion and support that feels like help. We take the time to match you with workers who understand your language, your culture and the way you like things done.

Language matchedWorkers who speak your language, so nothing important gets lost in translation.
Gender matchedAsk for a male or female worker for personal care. We match to your comfort.
Culturally responsiveCare that respects your faith, food and family, including Muslim and multicultural households.
Routine matchedThe same familiar faces where we can, matched to your week and how you like things done.
Getting started

Simple to start, easy to stay with

No pressure and no call-out fee. We listen first, then set up support that suits your plan and your goals.

Tell us what you need

Call or send an enquiry. We listen to your situation and your goals before anything else.

Free consultation and quote

We talk through your NDIS plan and what good support looks like for you, with fixed pricing and no call-out fee.

Meet your matched workers

We match workers to your language, gender, culture and routine, and introduce them before support begins.

Ongoing support that adapts

Support settles into your week and we adjust as your needs and goals change over time.

Office hours Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm. Support hours are arranged around your plan.

A good match makes support feel like help, not an intrusion. That is the difference families tell us they notice first.

Good questions

NDIS support, answered plainly

Yes. Ahsan Care Provider is a registered NDIS provider, number 4-L7JCZ6S. That means our supports are delivered to NDIS standards and our workers hold current NDIS Worker Screening. You can check any provider on the NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission (opens in a new tab) register.

We support participants across Melbourne from our Derrimut office, and across Sydney as a service area team. If you are not sure whether we reach your suburb, call us and we will tell you straight away.

We give you a free quote and fixed pricing, with no call-out fee. Support is charged in line with the NDIS price guide (opens in a new tab), and eligible supports are funded through your NDIS plan.

Yes, and many families do. Ask when you enquire and we will match you where we can, which is common for personal care and for culturally responsive support.

Our office is open Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm. The hours your support is delivered depend on your plan and the roster we set up together.

Send an enquiry or call our team. We arrange a free consultation to understand your goals, then set up a quote and introduce your matched workers before support begins.
